### Review Summary & Findings Assessment

This review evaluates the staged TRIAGE remediation candidate in [review-bundle.md](file:///tmp/pl-panel-hficlz68/review/review-bundle.md) against authoritative guidance in [review-instructions.md](file:///tmp/pl-panel-hficlz68/review/review-instructions.md) for [Consiliency/omniagent-plus](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus).

#### 1. Inventory & Ownership Coverage
- **Complete Inventory**: All 55 named audit findings (SL-1–SL-12, CC-1–CC-7, TR-1–TR-9, CO-1–CO-8, CLI-1–CLI-4, WL-1–WL-7, ID-1–ID-2, HY-1–HY-6) and cross-cutting sections 3.1–3.4 are accounted for across tracking issues ([omniagent-plus#19](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus/issues/19)–[omniagent-plus#27](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus/issues/27)) and implementation phases.
- **Ownership Separation**: HY-2 decision ownership is assigned to maintainer issue [omniagent-plus#20](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus/issues/20), while package implementation and verification belong strictly to [omniagent-plus#27](https://github.com/Consiliency/omniagent-plus/issues/27).
- **Core File Ownership**: Shared redaction scanning is assigned to `packages/core-contracts/src/redaction.ts` without reverse dependencies; COORD explicitly owns state-ledger coordination files (`packages/state-ledger/src/coordination.ts` and `supabase-coordination-channel.ts`).

#### 2. Compatibility & Safety Decisions
- **Content & Path Projections**: Enforces field-allowlist projections for CLI/UI envelopes and health/profile outputs to prevent user-home or credential exposure while preserving operational absolute roots. Transport redaction labels (`content_allowed`, `content_redacted`, `metadata_only`) must truthfully match payloads and are validated via independently packed consumer tests.
- **Recovery Precedence**: Fixes tail-corruption recovery (SL-5) before tightening schema parsing (CC-2/CC-3); read paths fail closed without in-place mutation, and corrupt bytes are preserved. Monotonic sequence recovery does not depend solely on stale manifests.
- **Lease Safety**: Distinguishes local Git worktree locks from fleet `LeaseStore` authority. Destructive cleanup requires realpath containment, Git registration, independent holder liveness, and dirty-state checks. Absent directories reconcile via metadata without arbitrary deletion.
- **Identity Enforcement**: Pre-dispatch checks validate persisted route targets against established session identity/provider/harness rather than relying on request-only assertions.
- **CI Topology**: Configures a unified, non-skipping full gate on hosted GitHub Ubuntu; no compute-offload passes are inferred without a pinned container action and parity proof.

#### 3. Falsifiable Acceptance Cases
- All 28 `N` and `Q` findings as well as sections 3.1–3.4 define concrete test families (`CASE-*`) with explicit boundary assertions and negative controls.

#### 4. Bounded Phase Roadmap & TRIAGE Plan
- Phase DAG (`TRIAGE -> GUARD -> DATA -> (COORD | WIRE) -> INTEG -> PREP -> SHIP`) is well-ordered and acyclic.
- Phase plan `phase-plan-v2-TRIAGE.md` specifies lane SL-0 with bounded file ownership, prospective evidence tracking (`plans/evidence/v2/TRIAGE.json`), and clear separation between planning validation and runtime test execution.

---

### Review Limitations

- **Headless Environment**: Operating constraints prohibited running shell commands or validation scripts (e.g., `phase-loop validate-roadmap`, `git diff --check`, or node membership assertions). Claims could not be verified by execution.
- **Staged Bounds**: No inspection of unprovided external files (such as historical audit logs `docs/code-review-2026-09-01.md` or git history) was performed outside the staged bundle.

---

### Verdict

**AGREE**
